name: player_start_modal_loop_sfx_handle
description: zUtil_SaveGameState::StartModalLoopSfxHandle starts a modal loop sample at the player world position and stores the returned handle.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?StartModalLoopSfxHandle@zUtil_SaveGameState@@QAEXHM@Z at 0x4385f0 passed with zero unmasked mismatches after masking 4 COFF relocation bytes; Binary Ninja body is 57 bytes and the VC object symbol is 64 bytes with 7 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4385f0 shows thiscall shape: ECX is zUtil_SaveGameState, stack arguments are modalSfxIndex and sfxVolume, and the callee returns with retn 8.

The function loads primaryModalState->masterModalData->sfxEngine[index], calls zSndSample::PlayA3D with playerState->worldPos and the supplied volume, then stores the returned zSndPlayHandle at primaryModalState->modalSfxHandle[index].
The native smoke exercises the DirectSound-backed PlayA3D path and verifies that the returned handle is stored in the indexed modal state slot with the player world position propagated.
